Standing authorities in this repository:

- Project integration and limits: [customer-service-multi-agent](instructions/customer-service-multi-agent.instructions.md).
  User-specified targets and acceptance are intent, not deployment evidence. Read this before imported guidance.
  Four specialized judges are `factual_accuracy`, `task_completion`, `tone`, `consistency`;
  calibration-dependent deployment gates remain `uncalibrated` until human-label agreement qualifies.
- Work contract — `.github/instructions/work-contract.instructions.md`. Do the task, delegate only for clear gain, verify in proportion to what could break.
- Communication register — `.github/instructions/communication-register.instructions.md`. Answer first, substance stays, fluff dies.
- Project state — `README.md`. What exists, what works, what is left; updated when a change makes it wrong.
- Repository architecture: [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md). Read before placing or changing a component, contract, schema, deployment, or dependency edge.
- Capability ownership and reuse — `.github/instructions/architecture-principles.instructions.md`. Catalogue capabilities and reuse or extend existing owners before creating components. For authorized restructuring, follow `.github/protocols/protocol-capability-modularization/SKILL.md`.
- Capability discovery — match native skill descriptions and read the selected entry. Protocols have native workflow entries too. `harness-guide` is an optional catalogue lookup, not a required gateway. Pass selected entry paths, scope and permissions to delegated workers; do not assume context inheritance.
- Investigation notebook: imported optional capability, not a local `docs/notebook/` installation.
  Return bounded findings to the caller; do not invent notes or run missing commands.

Agent coordination: [the active roster](agents/README.md) defines `general-overseer` as the main
contact and `general-orchestrator` as owner of one verifiable increment per assignment. Teams return
evidence before follow-on work is commissioned. Specialists are optional, selected when they
remove real risk or unknowns. Existing worker assignments remain owned until their workers
return; roster changes do not reassign them.

No ticketing workflow, charters, approval gates, or mandatory delegation. Agents in `.github/agents/` and skills in `.github/skills/` are optional tools, invoked when they earn their cost.
